details.text: Built on a 3×3 grid. Each square is one stem wide, and most lowercase letters fill all nine.
Rounds start as a circle three stems wide, with a pointed lens cut from the middle column.
Arches are the top of that circle. Where it meets the stem, it peels away as a hairline.
Two thicknesses set the contrast: a full stem and a hairline. Curves swell from one to the other.
